Human Evaluation, Table . We conducted human evaluation on the outputs produced by our model MoKGE+SAG+OT and the baseline MoKGE for the α-NLG task. We randomly selected 30 generations from each model. The annotation was performed by 3 researchers in the lab. We instructed the annotators to score the diversity and correctness (quality) of each generation on a scale of 0 to 3.
